claims.text: Current research in Generative Information Retrieval (GenIR) can be categorized into Generative Retrieval (GR) and Reliable Response Generation.
Generative Retrieval leverages generative model parameters to memorize documents and enables retrieval by generating document identifiers directly without explicit indexing.
Reliable Response Generation employs language models to directly generate user-sought information without relying on traditional relevance matching constraints.
Traditional Information Retrieval methods rely on similarity matching.

evidence.description: Based on the form of information provided to users, current research in GenIR can be categorized into two aspects: (1) Generative Retrieval ( GR )... (2) Reliable Response Generation...
Generative Retrieval ( GR ) leverages the generative model’s parameters for memorizing documents, enabling retrieval by directly generating relevant document identifiers without explicit indexing.
Reliable Response Generation employs language models to directly generate information users seek, breaking the limitations of traditional IR in terms of document granularity and relevance matching...
Information Retrieval (IR) systems... have long been dominated by traditional methods relying on similarity matching.

methodologies.name: Systematic Literature Survey
methodologies.description: A systematic survey reviewing research progress, taxonomy, model structure, document identifiers, evaluation, and challenges in Generative Information Retrieval (GenIR).

limitations.text: Traditional Information Retrieval methods face limitations in document granularity and relevance matching.
